name: Release Version Synchronization Governance
summary: Adds governed release stamping and regression checks so the public website, cache keys, manifests and deployment metadata always move to the same version.
changes: Introduces a reusable release stamping tool with explicit previous and next version inputs
Synchronizes public version metadata, script cache keys, platform manifests and package metadata
Adds a permanent release-version synchronization quality gate
Fails QA when stale release numbers remain in deployable HTML, JavaScript or JSON
Ensures the visible website version follows every deployed platform release
Preserves the manifest as the canonical runtime source of truth
manual_review: Open the public website and confirm the footer and BETA badge show v2026.07.24.195
Hard refresh desktop and Android and confirm no assets are served with v194 cache keys
Open /control/ and confirm the platform version is v2026.07.24.195
Run npm run test:release-version-sync and confirm it passes
title: Release Version Synchronization Governance
